units: Num. R. s. 10 לשונו ע׳ his (the drunken man’s) tongue is tied.—Trnsf. (of a woman) עֲגוּמָה tied to an absent husband, prevented from marrying (cmp. עָגַן). Y. Snh. VI, 23ᶜ עד מתי … ואני יושבת ע׳ בביתי how long yet shall my husband dwell with thee (Alexandria), and I (Jerusalem) sit a living widow in my house; Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵈ ע׳ עליו … tied (lonely) for his sake.—
